title: Your Waymo will now listen to you with some help from Gemini
excerpt: Experience a more intuitive Waymo ride with Ojai
content_html:
Published Jul 29, 2026, 4:18 PM EDT

Timi is the news and deals reporter for Android Police, who has been reporting on technology since 2008. He has worked in tech retail and also the IT space, providing hardware and software support, which gives him a unique perspective on the tech that he covers. This allows him to effectively break down complex subjects into easy-to-read pieces that even casual readers can enjoy. Before joining Android Police, he was a news writer for XDA, where he eventually transitioned to covering deals. He also worked as an editor and reporter for Neowin, where he covered news and attended major tech events like CES. He also reviewed phones, tablets, PC products, and other devices. In addition, he also created video content for the Neowin YouTube channel.

Sign in to your Android Police account

Today, Waymo showcased its new Ojai experience, bringing a more intuitive and seamless software experience to its customers. In addition, Waymo will now take advantage of Google's Gemini AI assistant in order to give riders new ways to interact with "cabin controls, journey information, Waymo education, and everyday knowledge at the touch of a button."

A new look and feel with Waymo

As you can imagine, having Gemini at your fingertips provides riders with an easy and seamless way to interact with the vehicle. You can tell Gemini to turn on the air conditioning, or set the heat to a certain temperature. You can even ask about local hotspots in order to get a better sense of the world around you.

Waymo stresses that Gemini is independent of Waymo's own software system. So, while you will be able to tell Gemini to pull the car over, it will not recognize or be able to control "any aspects of the vehicle's movement or routing". Waymo also provides its customers with ultimate privacy, making the Gemini experience an option.

If you don't engage with it, Gemini will not be part of the ride experience. At the moment, this feature is in beta, so you may not see it in every ride or every city. However, if you're a Waymo rider, we recommend keeping an eye out for this feature in order to give it a try. Furthermore, you'll want to check out Ojai too.

Hi, Ojai

Waymo states that this is the first major upgrade to its interface in years, introducing a more "relaxed" feel and "dynamic screen elements". The goal is to make it all stress-free, with the menu system providing easier access to key ride information. This also extends to important controls for the cabin and media playback.

The cabin will now rely on a triple-screen setup to accomplish this, which will provide information to all passengers at a glance. The information on each screen will dynamically change based on how many riders are in the vehicle. For the most part, this all sounds quite exciting. And it's important to feel comfortable if you're riding a vehicle using autonomous driving technology.

Personally, I've never ridden in a Waymo before, but that's because I've never really seen them on the road where I live. Hopefully, when I visit a bigger city, I'll have the chance to give one a try. Have you ridden a Waymo? What was your experience like? Let us know in the comments.

发布于 2026 年 7 月 29 日下午 4:18（美国东部时间）

Timi 是 Android Police 的新闻和交易记者，自 2008 年以来一直在报道技术。 他曾在科技零售和 IT 领域工作，提供硬件和软件支持，这使他对他所涵盖的技术有独特的视角。 这使他能够有效地将复杂的主题分解成易于阅读的文章，即使是普通读者也能喜欢。 在加入 Android Police 之前，他是 XDA 的新闻撰稿人，最终转而报道交易。 他还曾担任 Neowin 的编辑和记者，报道新闻并参加 CES 等重大科技活动。 他还审查了手机、平板电脑、电脑产品和其他设备。 此外，他还为 Neowin YouTube 频道制作了视频内容。

登录您的 Android Police 帐户

今天，Waymo 展示了全新的 Ojai 体验，为客户带来更直观、无缝的软件体验。 此外，Waymo 现在将利用谷歌的 Gemini AI 助手，为乘客提供新的交互方式，“只需按一下按钮即可进行机舱控制、旅程信息、Waymo 教育和日常知识”。

Waymo 带来新的外观和感觉

正如您可以想象的那样，Gemini 触手可及，为乘客提供了一种简单、无缝的方式与车辆互动。 你可以告诉双子座打开空调，或者将暖气设置到一定的温度。 您甚至可以询问当地热点，以便更好地了解周围的世界。

Waymo 强调，Gemini 独立于 Waymo 自己的软件系统。 因此，虽然您可以告诉 Gemini 将车靠边停车，但它无法识别或无法控制“车辆移动或路线的任何方面”。 Waymo 还为其客户提供终极隐私，使 Gemini 体验成为一种选择。

如果您不参与其中，Gemini 将不会成为骑行体验的一部分。 目前，此功能处于测试阶段，因此您可能无法在每个游乐设施或每个城市看到它。 但是，如果您是 Waymo 骑手，我们建议您密切关注此功能，以便尝试一下。 此外，您还想看看 Ojai。

嗨奥海

Waymo 表示，这是多年来其界面的首次重大升级，引入了更“轻松”的感觉和“动态屏幕元素”。 我们的目标是让一切变得毫无压力，菜单系统可以更轻松地访问关键的骑行信息。 这也延伸到了机舱和媒体播放的重要控制。

客舱现在将依靠三屏设置来实现这一目标，这将为所有乘客提供一目了然的信息。 每个屏幕上的信息将根据车内乘客的数量动态变化。 在大多数情况下，这一切听起来都非常令人兴奋。 如果您乘坐的是使用自动驾驶技术的车辆，那么感到舒适非常重要。

就我个人而言，我以前从未骑过 Waymo，但那是因为我从未在我居住的道路上真正见过它们。 希望当我访问更大的城市时，我有机会尝试一下。 你骑过 Waymo 吗？ 你的经历是什么样的？ 请在评论中告诉我们。
